statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial rate control therapy
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
CPT code 93247 long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring is indicated
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
